searchText: Hey Guys, bit of a novice question. Will ETH validator PoS requirements ever be reduced from 32ETH? If not will there be a way to trustlessly stake less than 32ETH ? > Will ETH validator PoS requirements ever be reduced from 32ETH Probably not for the foreseeable future > If not will there be a way to trustlessly stake less than 32ETH ? That is definitely the idea yes! Some functionality needed for that was recently merged to the spec, but there's still more work to be done. Rocketpool allows for mini pools where you stake 16 eth and 16 eth comes from them in trust.
